description: Replaces Rack's module browser with the browser from Rack v0.6, or with modified versions of the v1 and v2 browsers carrying favourites, custom tags, width filtering and a preview loupe.
notes: in the v2 mod browser the width button cycles a chosen HP value through exact, that width or narrower, that width or wider, and off.
a single instance in the patch replaces the browser for the whole of Rack; the module has no controls on its panel.
menu: Auto-generate custom tags — assigns tags from a curated rule set by matching keywords against module names and descriptions; Delete custom tag removes one.
Determine width for all modules — measures every installed module's panel in HP, which fills the width filter without each module being browsed to first.
Browser settings — Export and Import carry the favourites, hidden modules and custom tags kept in the Rack user folder to another installation.
v0.6, v1 mod and v2 mod — pick which browser replaces Rack's own.
Search in descriptions, Sort by search score, Favorite mode, Highlight favorites and Magnifier overlay — the settings shared by the v1 and v2 browsers.
Apply VCV Libray Whitelist and Show deprecated models — limit the browser to the modules the library allows, and include ones their makers have deprecated.
Reset usage data, Reset hidden modules, Reset custom tags and Reset predefined tags — each empties what it names.
